verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents an observability section for monitoring and evaluating agents, tracking execution times, token usage and resource consumption. The GitHub README advertises real-time tracing with metrics, logs and traces, and AMP offers real-time execution monitoring of deployed crews. However, nothing in the evidence shows per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation spans in a trace UI, so the story's 'every call' granularity is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of span-level tracing of each LLM call and tool invocation, a description of the trace UI itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
